sources.title: UNSTOPPABLE SION GUIDE - In depth Sion Masterclass

passive.name: Glory in Death
passive.text: After being killed, Sion will temporarily reanimate with rapidly decaying Health. His attacks become very rapid, heal him, and deal bonus damage based on his target's maximum Health.

spells.name: Decimating Smash
spells.text: Sion charges a powerful swing in an area in front of himself that will deal damage to enemies when released. If he charges for enough time, enemies hit by the swing will also be knocked up and stunned.

spells.name: Soul Furnace
spells.text: Sion shields himself and can reactivate after 3 seconds to deal Magic Damage to enemies nearby. When Sion kills enemies, he passively gains maximum Health.

spells.name: Roar of the Slayer
spells.text: Sion fires a short range shockwave that damages and slows and reduces the Armor of the first enemy hit. If the shockwave hits a minion or monster, it will be knocked back, damaging, slowing, and reducing the Armor of all enemies that it passes through.

spells.name: Unstoppable Onslaught
spells.text: Sion charges in a direction, ramping up speed over time. He can steer his charge slightly with the mouse cursor location. When he collides with an enemy he deals damage and knocks them up based on the distance he has charged.

damage.value: Sion deals burst Magic Damage when he reactivates Soul Furnace near enemies.

archetype.value: Sion can build as a tank and play as an engager, peeler, or splitpusher.

axis.value: Sion can clear waves quickly, crash them into the turret, and look for a proxy.

winCondition.value: Sion can win through splitpushing, wave clear, and strong engage or peel.

spikes.at: As Sion gains health through infinite scaling
When Decimating Smash is charged long enough
spikes.why: Sion’s swing also knocks up and stuns enemies it hits.

bait.why: Sion can struggle to enter teamfights without his ultimate, making its cooldown a window to pressure him.

mistakes.value: Sion risks staying out of lane too long after crashing just one wave instead of returning with Teleport or his ultimate.
Sion misses Decimating Smash’s knockup and stun by releasing it before charging long enough.
